text:
maria: Heads-up: new advisory for grpc and oauth/jwt libs affecting our private deploys. CVE-2026-3345 (grpc) allows malformed metadata parsing causing potential panic/DoS; CVE-2026-4012 (go net/http) header parsing leading to request smuggling in edge cases. We need a triage + backport plan. @darin can you take lead on grpc? :eyes:

Darin: On it. quick question: which services use older grpc tags? I know dedicated clusters run 1.52.x for binary compatibility. Private on-prem installer vendors are stuck on 1.50. Do we need to backport to 1.50 too?

alex: We vendor deps into the on-prem bundle for air-gapped installs. Backporting might be easier by creating an internal patch branch and tagging a replacement in go.mod: ```replace google.golang.org/grpc => github.com/redwood/grpc v1.50.8-redwood1``` I'll prep the vendor diff.

jin: FWIW oauth/jwt lib has a fix in v1.2.3 that addressed a token validation edge-case. If we can't upgrade, consider patching with a minimal upstream PR + fork. For net/http, the fix requires bumping stdlib; that's harder for older go runtime versions. Which go versions are our on-prem builds using?

maria: On-prem images are built with go1.19 for legacy customers, and CI images use go1.21. So net/http fix probably requires we ship a runtime upgrade or a proxy mitigation.

Darin: Plan proposal: 1) grpc: create a backport branch for 1.50.x and cherry-pick upstream fix, 2) oauth/jwt: vendor patched minimal fork & add `go.sum` attestations, 3) net/http: add ingress proxy mitigation rule to drop suspicious header patterns + file an engineering ticket to upgrade runtime for next minor release.

alex: Adding checklist: update vendor/, update go.mod with `replace` so rebuilds are deterministic, run `go test ./...` and `make release-bundle` for on-prem, and run fuzz harness on edge cases. I'll own vendoring.

jin: We should also add audit log markers to the deploy so we can trace builds that include patched deps (KMS key used to sign artifacts). Audit logging: add `build.artifact.signed_by` and KMS key id metadata.

sec-bot: Automated scan result: DependencyCheck flagged grpc@v1.50.2 and golang.org/x/oauth2@v0.0.0-202... as vulnerable. PRs required: #sec/grpc-backport, #sec/oauth-fork, #ops/runtime-upgrade.

maria: Timeline: emergency patch for on-prem within 48 hours for grpc/oauth, mitigation for net/http within 24 hours (proxy rule), and full runtime upgrade scheduled in 6 weeks. Can everyone add blockers to their calendars? :calendar: 

Darin: I'll create the backport PR today and add tests. ping me if you need access to the secondary signing KMS key.

alex: Uploading vendor diff to the internal s3 and opening PR with `replace` and vendor/ + checksums. Will tag release and notify release-bot.

jin: I'll add audit log fields and create a deploy playbook for customers who need local install patches. Also will coordinate with support for customer comms.

maria: Thanks. Assigning action owners: @darin grpc backport, @alex vendor & release bundle, @jin audit/logging+playbook, @maria will coordinate CS comms and compliance signoff. Update thread with PR links when ready.
